info.name: Sanad Care Homes — Facility Owner
info.description: Facility-owner portal endpoints only. Token: owner account authorized by CareHomeOwnerAccess.

item.name: 01. Facility onboarding and profile
item.description: Owner-scoped draft lifecycle. Login requests use local test fixtures; replace credentials outside local development.

exec: pm.test('created or already exists for the one-facility owner rule', () => pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: CareHomeOwnerAccess. Returns 200 with the caller's facility (id, status, version, openRevisionId, draft, submittedProfile, approvedProfile, documents, review history) including Draft facilities; 404 CareHomes.Facility.NotFound when the owner has no facility. submittedProfile is the pending-review revision (revisionId plus profile projection) and is null otherwise; approvedProfile follows approvedRevisionId and remains available while a newer editable draft exists. openRevisionId identifies the current editable revision or null. Editing an approved facility creates a new editable revision that inherits approved documents/media by referencing the same stored files; document verification attribution/expiry and rejected or expired states are preserved, and removing an inherited media record does not delete a shared file while another revision references it. The GET never creates, saves, mutates, or backfills a draft or revision assets. Verified PORTAL-05 on an isolated host.

CareHomeOwnerAccess. Saves the editable draft and returns the refreshed facility. cancellationTerms is the facility's structured cancellation schedule (clause 6 of the approved refund policy): 1-6 tiers, each with refundPercentage 0-100 and deadlineHoursBeforeStart 0-8760; tiers are normalized longest-deadline-first and duplicate deadlines are rejected. Omitting cancellationTerms or sending null clears previously published terms (replacement semantics). Invalid tiers return the CareHomes.Facility.InvalidProfile failure. Terms become the snapshot a booking preserves once the Owner-approved refund policy is activated.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.collectionVariables.set('careHomeFacilityVersion', pm.response.json().version); pm.test('English name round-trips', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().draft.englishName).to.eql('Hope House')); }

if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('cancellation terms round-trip', () => { const tiers = pm.response.json().draft.cancellationTerms.tiers; pm.expect(tiers).to.have.lengthOf(2); pm.expect(tiers[0]).to.eql({ refundPercentage: 100, deadlineHoursBeforeStart: 24 }); pm.expect(tiers[1]).to.eql({ refundPercentage: 50, deadlineHoursBeforeStart: 12 }); });
pm.test('document is stored pending review', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('document metadata is readable by its owner', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.collectionVariables.set('careHomeFacilityVersion', pm.response.json().version); pm.test('license is pending review', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().documents.some(d => d.type === 1 && d.status === 1)).to.eql(true)); }

item.name: 05. Booking decisions and cancellation
item.description: Source-authored HC-TASK-032 booking and HC-036 extension examples. Requires the disposable Development fixture variables below, including an accepted/paid booking for the extension request, and an effective Finance rule. These requests have not been runtime-verified; do not point them at production or reset a database to make them runnable.

request.description: CareHomeOwnerAccess. Lists paid requests for the owner's facility only (200 array; empty array when no paid bookings; 404 CareHomes.Bookings.NotFound when the owner has no facility). Pending-payment holds are excluded. Verified PORTAL-05 on an isolated host.
CareHomeOwnerAccess. Accept moves PaidAwaitingDecision to Accepted. Reject requires a reason, moves to RefundPending, and initiates a full refund when a transaction exists.

item.name: 06. Stay operations
item.description: Source-authored HC-034 room/bed assignment, actual facility check-in/out, Family confirmation, Family-submitted dispute, owner operational readback, and Admin dispute resolution. Requires an accepted booking and disposable fixture IDs. Check-out without Family confirmation opens a case immediately; a Family dispute requires a booking owned by that Family with facility check-in recorded. These examples are authored, not runtime evidence.

request.description: CareHomeOwnerAccess. Shared stays require a bed; Private/Suite stays must send bedId as null and reserve the whole room. The room must match the booking facility and room type. Invalid allocation returns 400 CareHomes.Bookings.InvalidAssignment; an occupied resource returns 409 CareHomes.Bookings.AssignmentConflict.
CareHomeOwnerAccess. Records the server UTC actual check-in for an accepted, assigned booking. Repeated or invalid lifecycle transitions return 409 CareHomes.Bookings.InvalidState.

CareHomeOwnerAccess. Returns assigned room/bed, the booking's stored residentArabicName/residentEnglishName/residentAge snapshots (never recalculated from current Elderly/Identity records), actual facility timestamps and actors, and Family confirmation timestamp/actor.

CareHomeOwnerAccess. Records server UTC actual check-out. If Family confirmation is missing, opens one Open Admin case immediately; no timeout is used. Repeated/invalid transitions return 409 CareHomes.Bookings.InvalidState.

Transfer effective dates must be Cairo-local, non-backdated, and within the stay. No fixture setup, DB reset, or provider request is included.

Success preserves booking room type and price/payment snapshots, appends transfer history and queues Family in-app/email notifications. item.name: 08. Facility cancellation
item.description: Requires separate disposable bookings in the indicated states. Family cancellation before recorded check-in refunds totalAmount; after recorded check-in it refunds 50%. Owner cancellation of an accepted stay refunds the full amount. Admin recovery requires a failed or externally completed refund. No requests reset or seed the database.

item.name: 09. Care-home visits
item.description: CareHomeOwnerAccess only. Schedule edits are versioned and rejected if they invalidate already reserved visits. Authored examples only; no runtime/fixture evidence claimed.

request.description: CareHomeOwnerAccess. Reads visitor capacity, operating hours, visiting windows and closure dates (200; version 0 with capacity 0 before first save; 404 CareHomes.Visits.NotFound when the owner has no facility). Verified PORTAL-05 on an isolated host.

CareHomeOwnerAccess. Lists visits for the caller's facility ordered by start time (200 array; empty array when none; 404 CareHomes.Visits.NotFound when the owner has no facility). Verified PORTAL-05 on an isolated host with populated, empty and cross-owner states.
Approve a still-pending visit. Set approve false and provide a reason to reject.

body.raw: { "approve": false, "reason": "Unable to host at this time" }

request.description: Rejects a still-pending request. A nonblank reason is required.
Cancels a visit before its start time.

CareHomeOwnerAccess. Replaces versioned schedule settings (200, version increments). Day uses numeric DayOfWeek (1 = Monday); string names are rejected with 400. Stale expectedVersion returns 409 CareHomes.Visits.Conflict; capacity below 1 returns 400 CareHomes.Visits.InvalidRequest; failed writes leave settings/version unchanged. Verified PORTAL-05 on an isolated host.

item.name: 05. Check-in disputes (read only)
item.description: CareHomeOwnerAccess. Lists only cases for the authenticated owner's facility. No facility selector or owner resolution action. Query page (default 1), pageSize (default 25; 1–100), optional status (Open/Resolved, case-insensitive). An owner without a facility receives an empty page. Loading/empty/error states are read-only; Sanad support handles cases. Case outcomes do not rewrite facility check-in/out timestamps.

request.description: 200: { page, pageSize, totalCount, items }. Items include nullable checkoutOnUtc, familyReason, residentArabicName/residentEnglishName, originalBookingTotalAmount/originalBookingCurrency, effectiveCheckInOnUtc and resolvedOnUtc. Missing booking enrichment fields are null. Admin evidence, rationale and resolver ID are not returned. Invalid query values use the standard validation response.

item.name: Legal pages (app reads)
item.description: Signed-in Care Home Owner legal content. LegalAudience numeric: CareHomeOwner=5 (AccountType.CareHomeOwner is 8; the two value spaces are never cast into one another). Audience is derived from the token's account_type claims; an optional ?audience=5 query parameter names the owner audience explicitly when the token owns more than one, validated against the owned audiences (400 Cms.Content.InvalidAudience malformed, 400 Cms.Content.AudienceRequired omitted+multiple, 403 Cms.Content.UnsupportedAudience unowned). Returns only the current Published version; missing publication returns 404 Cms.Legal.NotPublished. No realistic legal text in examples.

request.description: NormalAccess policy; Normal access token with an active CareHomeOwner account-type claim. Resolves to LegalAudience.CareHomeOwner=5 (auto-selected when the token owns exactly one audience; otherwise send ?audience=5). 200 LegalDocumentResponse or 404 Cms.Legal.NotPublished; a malformed ?audience= is 400 Cms.Content.InvalidAudience and an unowned one is 403 Cms.Content.UnsupportedAudience.

NormalAccess policy; Normal access token with an active CareHomeOwner account-type claim. Same audience rules as the privacy-policy request (?audience=5 names the owner audience when the token owns more than one). 200 LegalDocumentResponse or 404 Cms.Legal.NotPublished.

NormalAccess policy; authenticated Care Home Owner read. CareHomeOwner is a Help Center audience (F5): the owner reads only its own active FAQs plus the shared global support contact card. ?audience=5 selects the owner audience explicitly for a multi-account token. 200 HelpCenterResponse with faqs [] and supportContact null before any CMS seeding; a malformed ?audience= is 400 Cms.Content.InvalidAudience, an unowned one (or an admin account type) is 403 Cms.Content.UnsupportedAudience.

item.name: 10. Facility ratings (F7)
item.description: CareHomeOwnerAccess rating visibility. The owner reads the ratings about their own facility anonymously — hidden ratings leave the page and both aggregates and the reviewer is never identified — and may flag a rating for Sanad support. There is no owner hide, restore or keep. Owner read and flag only; these examples are authored, not runtime evidence.

request.description: CareHomeOwnerAccess. Returns 200 with items, page, pageSize, totalCount (visible ratings counted before paging), averageStars (over the visible ratings, rounded half away from zero to two decimals) and ratingCount. Items are ordered newest-first and carry only ratingId, stars, reviewText, createdOnUtc, flagStatus (None/Open/Resolved for this owner's own latest flag), myFlagReason and myFlaggedOnUtc. Hidden ratings are excluded from both the page and the aggregates. Invalid paging is 400 CareHomes.Rating.InvalidQuery; an owner account with no facility is 404 CareHomes.Facility.NotFound.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('page'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('pageSize'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('totalCount'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('averageStars'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('ratingCount'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('items').that.is.an('array'); if (body.items.length > 0) { pm.collectionVariables.set('careHomeRatingId', body.items[0].ratingId); pm.expect(body.items[0]).to.have.property('stars'); pm.expect(body.items[0].flagStatus).to.be.oneOf(['None', 'Open', 'Resolved']); } const raw = JSON.stringify(body); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('familyId'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('userId'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('reviewerName'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('phoneNumber'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('email'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('avatarUrl'); }

item.name: Second page of my facility ratings

request.description: Paging is echoed exactly: page 2 with pageSize 1 returns the second-newest visible rating. totalCount still counts every visible rating before paging and averageStars/ratingCount stay whole-set, so a single page never changes the aggregates.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.page).to.equal(2); pm.expect(body.pageSize).to.equal(1); pm.expect(body.items.length).to.be.at.most(1); }

request.description: Paging is validated, never clamped: a page below 1 or a pageSize outside 1–100 returns 400 CareHomes.Rating.InvalidQuery rather than a silently different page.

CareHomeOwnerAccess. Opens one unresolved flag on a rating about the owner's own facility and returns 204 No Content; reason is required and at most 500 characters. An unknown rating, or a rating about another facility, is the same 404 CareHomes.Rating.NotFound; a blank or over-500-character reason is 400 CareHomes.Rating.InvalidReason. No reviewer identity appears in any outcome. Run "List my facility ratings" first to populate careHomeRatingId.

item.name: Repeat flag while open is a no-op

request.description: Run immediately after "Flag a rating": at most one unresolved flag exists per rating per owner, so a repeat while it is still open returns 204 and writes nothing — no duplicate flag row and no history row — and the stored reason stays the first one. Flagging again after the case was resolved opens a fresh case.

exec: pm.test('repeat flag is an idempotent 204', () => pm.expect([204, 400, 401, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: A missing, blank or over-500-character reason returns 400 CareHomes.Rating.InvalidReason. The reason is trimmed before it is stored and before this check, so whitespace alone is not a reason.
An unknown rating id and a rating about another facility answer the same 404 CareHomes.Rating.NotFound, so the route never confirms whether a foreign rating exists.

item.name: Owner is denied on the admin rating routes

request.description: CareHomesOperationalAdmin is a Normal-access SuperAdmin (5) or SupportAdmin (7) policy, so the same facility-owner token that reads /facilities/mine/ratings is 403 here. Owners cannot list, hide, keep or restore ratings.

exec: pm.test('owner denied on admin ratings', () => pm.expect([401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: 11. Resident care records
item.description: Facility-owner-only care records for residents with an Accepted booking at this facility. Every read/write rechecks facility ownership and accepted-resident scope. Mutations require an approved disposable fixture.

request.description: Names only for residents with an Accepted booking at the owner's facility. No medical data is returned. Optional search= is trimmed and then matched against the Arabic or English mapped names case-insensitively as literal text: '%' , '_' and backslash are escaped, so they match themselves (a search of '%' returns only a name that literally contains a percent sign — it is never a wildcard and never ignored). A trimmed search longer than 100 characters or a page/pageSize outside 1-100 returns 400 Families.CareRecords.InvalidQuery. Ordering is mapped-name then id, stable for pagination.
CareHome-source records only; resident must have an Accepted booking at the owner's facility.
